name: AHV pension with real wage growth and inflation: credits drift, limits grow
workings: Born 1966-07-01; 30 Swiss contribution years at an average income of 80,000.00.
At 63 (2029): average 76,494.05; monthly 2,330.32 for a full record × 30/44 × 0.864 × 1.005^3 = 1,393.4654; a year 18,115.0508 (13 payments); the first year 5 months and their 13th: 7,547.9378.
At 65 (2031): average 74,242.54; monthly 2,300.30 for a full record × 30/44 × 1.000 × 1.005^5 = 1,607.9904; a year 20,903.8757 (13 payments); the first year 5 months and their 13th: 8,709.9482.
At 70 (2036): average 68,899.43; monthly 2,229.06 for a full record × 30/44 × 1.315 × 1.005^10 = 2,100.7604; a year 27,309.8855 (13 payments); the first year 5 months and their 13th: 11,379.1189.

Credited incomes are nominal while the formula's limits follow the mixed index: each year the average loses 1/(1.01 × 1.005) against them; the pension, in today's francs, grows by 0.5% a year until it starts and after (realGrowthPerYear).
